thread:
jamal: Hey people-ops — quick Q. Baby born overseas last week. We have hospital letter + local birth cert, still waiting on SSN. Can I add the baby to medical now under a QLE? What docs do you need and can I enroll in Dependent Care FSA midyear too?

sara: Congrats! You should be able to add under the birth QLE within the 30-day window. For foreign births we generally need the birth certificate (certified copy) and a hospital letter; if the birth cert isn’t in English we ask for a certified translation. If the country requires an apostille, include it too. SSN can be added later once issued.

jamal: Perfect. Any special steps in Workday or a checklist I can follow? Also payroll proration — will deductions start immediately?

sara: Upload to Workday: Benefits > Add dependent > Attach docs. If you hit any upload problems, DM me and I can intake manually. For payroll: deductions start after the benefits change is processed by HR before the payroll cutoff. If processed before the cutoff it applies that pay period, otherwise next one. There’s a short proration if you start mid-pay-period.

lisa: tagging payroll ops: @payroll — FYI Jamal may submit after hours, can we confirm how proration is calculated and whether we can expedite processing for medical start date aligned to birth date?

payroll-bot: Payroll cutoff for benefit changes is 5pm PT, two business days before the pay run. Changes after cutoff go into the following cycle. Proration = (monthly election amount) / (remaining pay periods in the plan year) rounded to cents. To expedite, submit docs and email payroll@redwood with thread link.

maria: Also: Dependent Care FSA is eligible after a qualifying life event — you can elect midyear. Note that DC FSA election amounts are prorated based on when enrollment becomes effective. SSN isn’t required to enroll but will be required for tax forms later, so keep documentation.

jamal: One more — can medical be retroactive to date of birth so we can file claims for the newborn’s NICU care?

sara: Yes, most carriers allow coverage retroactive to the birth date if added within the QLE window. For NICU claims, submit the claim with the temporary member ID and then update once SSN is on file. If you need help with a carrier claim, email benefits@redwood and include the hospital bill + proof of enrollment request and we’ll flag it for expedited review.

jamal: Thanks everyone — I’ll upload certified translation + hospital letter tonight and DM @sara when done :thumbsup:
